purpose: Teach Bossman to compare meaningful prior state and structural levels instead of only adjacent ~15s frames.

current_visual_observation.source_note: Values read from owner-provided screenshot; keep UNVERIFIED until local calibrated extractor/reviewer confirms exact pixels.

derived_candidate_state.important_caveat: OI is total open interest and does not identify long/short side by itself. The regime comes from joint Price/CVD/OI behavior.

structural_interpretation.bullish_invalidation_of_bear_case: Hold/reclaim dPOC with CVD stabilization/recovery weakens the bearish continuation interpretation.
structural_interpretation.bearish_confirmation: Loss of dPOC followed by failed reclaim while CVD remains weak and OI stays elevated/rises strengthens bearish continuation evidence.

training_lessons: Do not classify market state only from adjacent 15-second samples when the deltas round to FLAT.
Maintain 15m, 30m and 60m comparisons from compatible VERIFIED series.
A large CVD deterioration with price down and OI up is materially different from NEUTRAL_BALANCE.
Structural levels must be part of the interpretation when explicitly visible and verified.
dPOC is a decision point, not an automatic long or short signal; require hold/reclaim or loss/failed-reclaim evidence.
Never print UNKNOWN level/scenario blocks when the data is simply unavailable; either verify levels or omit the block.
Never promote screenshot-read approximate levels into trusted memory without calibrated local verification.
future_labels_required: whether dPOC held, reclaimed, or was lost
promotion_rule: Promote only after exact screenshot extraction is independently verified and future 15m/30m/60m outcomes are attached.
